title: Types, categories, dates and missing values in pandas

videos.script: A column's type is a claim about what it holds. {{claim}} Text says text. A datetime says a moment. A category says one of a few known values. {{types}} When the claim is wrong, everything after it is wrong in a way that looks fine. {{fine}} Dates stored as text sort by luck and cannot be subtracted. Numbers stored as text hide a typo, a letter O where a zero should be. {{text}} This lesson gives each column the type it deserves. {{give}} It turns the trip times into datetimes, and every trip gets a duration. {{durations}} It attaches Recife's time zone, so a server in UTC agrees with the files. {{zones}} And it looks at what pandas does with a missing value when you did not ask. The sum of nothing is zero. That is worth knowing before it lands in a report. {{end}}
